description.content:
Comprehensive testing suite for BRD (Business Requirements Document) coverage validation across VDS Insurance Platform services.

## Overview
This collection validates that all required BRD sections (3.1-3.5 and 4.1-4.11) are properly mapped to microservices in the VDS Insurance Platform.

## Test Coverage
- BRD Coverage Validation Script Execution
- JSON Report Structure Validation
- Coverage Percentage Verification
- Service Mapping Validation
- High-Priority Service BRD Alignment

## Usage
```bash
newman run "BRD-Validation-API.postman_collection.json" -e "brd-validation-environment.json"
```
